name: composer
title: Composer
description: Where a message or a prompt is written: a growing field over a row of tools.
use: Writing a message or a prompt to send: a chat, a reply, an assistant. The sheet is a form, so the send button submits it.

instead.when: Longer text is one field among others in a form, under a label

keyboard.action: Adds a line, as a textarea does. A listener can send on Enter instead; say so in a composer-hint
With that listener, adds a line

platform.fallback: The field keeps three lines and scrolls from there

classes.name: composer
classes.description: The raised sheet around the field and its tools, on a form. It draws the field's focus, and gives its buttons the concentric corner

classes.name: composer-field
classes.description: The textarea, with no material of its own. It grows with its content from --composer-rows to --composer-max-rows lines, then scrolls

classes.name: composer-attachments
classes.description: A wrapping row above the field for what goes with the message: chips or thumbnails

classes.name: composer-toolbar
classes.description: The row of tools under the field

classes.name: composer-end
classes.description: The group pushed to the end of the toolbar, where the send button goes

classes.name: composer-hint
classes.description: A quiet note beside the tools, on one line: a model's name, a character count, a shortcut

states.name: disabled
states.description: The sheet settles into a well and stops lifting; disable the send button with it

properties.name: --composer-max-rows
properties.description: Lines after which the field scrolls

properties.name: --composer-inset
properties.description: The sheet's padding, and the inset its buttons' corners follow

example: 0 / 2000
